{"action":"done","summary":"Implemented cachetools.tagged.TaggedCache(maxsize) in src/cachetools/tagged.py, backed by cachetools.LRUCache via a private _TaggedLRUCache subclass that reports evicted keys so tag memberships are cleaned on eviction. R01: put(key,value,tags=()) deep-copies values on input, get() returns a detached deep copy and raises KeyError on miss; tags validated as a finite iterable of strings (bare str and non-string entries rejected with ValueError before any state change), deduplicated preserving order. R02: invalidate(tag) removes exactly entries carrying the tag and returns the count; replacement drops old tag memberships before the LRU update and adds new ones; eviction cleans memberships so key reuse is unaffected; get() refreshes LRU recency; len() counts live entries. R03: maxsize must be a positive int excluding bool (ValueError otherwise); invalid replacement input leaves old value/tags/recency unchanged (verified by test); every value costs one capacity slot. Claim-A extension: overwriting an existing key via put refreshes its LRU recency (becomes MRU), covered by dedicated tests. Also added mapping helpers (__getitem__, __delitem__, pop, clear, maxsize/currsize, __contains__, __len__, __repr__). Wrote tests/test_tagged.py (23 tests). Verified: PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q -> 239 passed; upstream test files unchanged (git status shows only new files tagged.py, test_tagged.py, HANDOFF.md).","completion_asserted":true}
